_about: Learner-list cross-check (spec Phase 2, done early for ja and zh). Subtitle counts make textbook words such as 傘 (umbrella) or 碗 (bowl) look rare, so a learner who ticks them was read one level too high. tools/add-k.mjs sets k = min(corpus k, cap) for the words below and keeps the corpus value in k0 and the list level in lv. Cap = about 2x the cumulative size of the learner list up to that level, rounded: JLPT N5 (~700 words) and HSK 2.0 levels 1-3 (600 words) -> 1,500; JLPT N4 (~1,400) and HSK 2.0 level 4 (1,200) -> 3,000. Levels were assigned from the standard lists (JLPT: Jonathan Waller's lists, CC BY; HSK 2.0 / 2012 syllabus; all HSK 2.0 level 1-3 words are also in HSK 3.0 levels 1-3); re-check them against the list files before ads. Only words on the test pages are listed; N4 / HSK 4 words are listed for completeness even where the cap changes nothing.
